entry.title: Day 4: Historical Date Converter
entry.summary: A converter that turns a Julian date (from the old calendar) into a Gregorian date (today's calendar), and back, for the place you pick. It flags dates that never existed there, like 13 October 1582 in Rome. Made for family historians and anyone reading old letters: a sample is loaded, so change the day or place, or try a famous date.

entry.title: Day 3: Between Periods
entry.summary: A game that lets you drive an ice-resurfacing machine around a hockey rink and buff every scar in the ice before the buzzer. For hockey fans and anyone who likes quick challenges. Press Start intermission to take the wheel.

entry.title: Day 2: Orbital Knitwear
entry.summary: A simulation that shows how a satellite's orbit sweeps over the Earth, drawn as a track on a flat map. It is for anyone curious about satellites. Drag the Height or Tilt slider and watch what the orbit covers. The knitting is decoration: needles are satellites.

entry.title: Day 1: Jokers In Phase
entry.summary: A scoring puzzle in the style of a joker-card game: swap jokers into a better order and the same four poker hands score far more. Made for puzzle fans, with no poker knowledge needed. Start with First Beat: tap one joker, then another, to swap them.
